title: ai-playbook curate move-plan (v1)
description: The LLM-produced plan consumed by scripts/curate.py. It describes MOVES of existing prose from a dispatcher (.md) file to a destination (a leaf doc, or the canonical AGENTS.md), each leaving a thin pointer behind. The plan never carries NEW prose: scripts/_curate_validate.py rejects any move whose source_excerpt is not a verbatim substring of the named source file. The LLM never writes to disk — curate.py validates the plan structurally, snapshots BASE, then performs the moves itself.

source_rel_path.description: Dispatcher file the prose currently lives in (e.g. CLAUDE.md). Must be one of the files curate detected drift in.

source_excerpt.description: VERBATIM substring of the source file to relocate. Validation rejects anything that is not byte-for-byte present in the source — the LLM may only move existing content, never invent it.

dest_rel_path.description: Where the prose goes: a leaf doc under docs/ (created/appended) or the canonical AGENTS.md. No absolute paths, no `..` traversal; must end with .md.

pointer.description: The thin pointer left in the dispatcher in place of the excerpt — a short line containing a markdown link to dest_rel_path. Keeps the dispatcher pointer-shaped (principle #2).
